newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: European gold starts firmer ahead of OTC expiry.
newsitem.headline: European gold starts firmer ahead of OTC expiry.

text.p: Gold opened $1.45 firmer in Europe on Monday, but it was in a stable range as the market held back ahead of the expiry of over the counter (OTC) options on Tuesday, traders said.
Gold started in Zurich at $325.25/325.75 an ounce after closing in London at $323.80/324.30 on Friday.
"It is very quiet ahead of the options expiry," one trader said.
Gold was expected to hover in a range of $323/328.
Traders saw potential for a move up out of a range of $4.30/4.40. But the general lack of activity could hamper this.
Palladium was barely firmer at $200.00/203.00, against $199.00/201.00.
